from solution import Service


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


def setup(**kw):
    c = Clock()
    s = Service(c, **kw)
    s.register_user("ann", "member")
    s.register_user("bob", "member")
    s.register_user("st", "staff")
    for i in range(5):
        s.add_item("i%d" % i, "Thing")
    return c, s


def test_register_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.register_user("", "member")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", "admin")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user(1, "member")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", "member")[0] == 201
    assert s.register_user("a", "staff")[0] == 409


def test_add_item_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.add_item("", "x")[0] == 400
    assert s.add_item("a", "")[0] == 400
    assert s.add_item("a", "x")[0] == 201
    assert s.add_item("a", "y")[0] == 409
    assert s.add_item("b", "x")[0] == 201


def test_checkout_order_and_limits():
    c, s = setup()
    assert s.checkout("zed", "nope")[0] == 404
    assert s.checkout("ann", "nope")[0] == 404
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i0") == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 1007.0})
    assert s.checkout("bob", "i0")[0] == 409
    s.checkout("ann", "i1")
    s.checkout("ann", "i2")
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i3")[0] == 422
    assert s.item_status("i0") == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": 1})


def test_max_loans_zero():
    c, s = setup(max_loans=0)
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i0")[0] == 422


def test_return_rules():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    lid = b["loan_id"]
    assert s.return_loan("ann", 99)[0] == 404
    assert s.return_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.return_loan("st", lid) == (200, {"item_id": "i0"})
    assert s.return_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 409
    assert s.item_status("i0") == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None})
    assert s.checkout("bob", "i0")[0] == 200


def test_renew_rules():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    lid = b["loan_id"]
    assert s.renew_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", 42)[0] == 404
    assert s.renew_loan("st", lid) == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0})
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid) == (200, {"due_at": 1021.0})
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 422


def test_renew_overdue_boundary():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    c.t = 1007.0
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 200
    c.t = 1014.5
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 409


def test_renew_returned_409():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    s.return_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 409


def test_list_loans():
    c, s = setup()
    assert s.list_loans("zed")[0] == 404
    s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    s.checkout("bob", "i1")
    s.checkout("ann", "i2")
    s.return_loan("ann", 1)
    st, loans = s.list_loans("ann")
    assert st == 200
    assert [l["loan_id"] for l in loans] == [1, 3]
    assert [l["status"] for l in loans] == ["returned", "active"]
    assert set(loans[0]) == {"loan_id", "item_id", "due_at", "renewals_used", "status"}

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t


def make(**kw):
    clock = Clock(1000.0)
    svc = Service(clock, **kw)
    assert svc.register_user("m1", "member")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register_user("m2", "member")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register_user("s1", "staff")[0] == 201
    for i in range(1, 7):
        assert svc.add_item(f"i{i}", f"name{i}")[0] == 201
    return svc, clock


# ---------------- REQ-1 register_user ----------------

def test_register_user_success_body():
    """register_user with valid id and role must return 201 with {user_id, role}."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    out = svc.register_user("alice", "member")
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": "alice", "role": "member"}), f"input=('alice','member') output={out!r}"
    out = svc.register_user("bob", "staff")
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": "bob", "role": "staff"}), f"input=('bob','staff') output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("uid,role", [
    ("", "member"), (None, "member"), (5, "member"), (b"a", "member"),
    ("u", ""), ("u", "admin"), ("u", "Member"), ("u", "STAFF"), ("u", None), ("u", 1),
])
def test_register_user_invalid_is_400(uid, role):
    """register_user must return 400 when user_id or role is invalid."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    out = svc.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input=({uid!r},{role!r}) output={out!r}"


def test_register_user_duplicate_409_and_role_unchanged():
    """register_user must return 409 for an existing user_id and must not change the stored role."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.register_user("m1", "staff")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1','staff') output={out!r}"
    c = svc.checkout("m2", "i1")
    assert c[0] == 200, f"input=('m2','i1') output={c!r}"
    out = svc.return_loan("m1", c[1]["loan_id"])
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m1', loan) after failed re-register output={out!r}"


@given(uid=st.text(min_size=1), role=st.sampled_from(["member", "staff"]))
def test_register_user_property_valid_201(uid, role):
    """register_user must return 201 echoing user_id and role for any valid input."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    out = svc.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": uid, "role": role}), f"input=({uid!r},{role!r}) output={out!r}"
    out2 = svc.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out2[0] == 409, f"input=({uid!r},{role!r}) second output={out2!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-2 add_item ----------------

def test_add_item_success_body():
    """add_item with valid id and name must return 201 with {item_id, name}."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    out = svc.add_item("x", "Drill")
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": "x", "name": "Drill"}), f"input=('x','Drill') output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("iid,name", [
    ("", "n"), (None, "n"), (3, "n"), ("x", ""), ("x", None), ("x", 7),
])
def test_add_item_invalid_is_400(iid, name):
    """add_item must return 400 when item_id or name is invalid."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    out = svc.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input=({iid!r},{name!r}) output={out!r}"


def test_add_item_duplicate_409_same_name_ok():
    """add_item must return 409 for a duplicate item_id but allow distinct items to share a name."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    assert svc.add_item("a", "Same")[0] == 201
    out = svc.add_item("a", "Other")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('a','Other') output={out!r}"
    out = svc.add_item("b", "Same")
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": "b", "name": "Same"}), f"input=('b','Same') output={out!r}"


@given(iid=st.text(min_size=1), name=st.text(min_size=1))
def test_add_item_property(iid, name):
    """add_item must return 201 for valid input and 409 on repeating the item_id."""
    svc = Service(Clock())
    out = svc.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": iid, "name": name}), f"input=({iid!r},{name!r}) output={out!r}"
    out2 = svc.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out2[0] == 409, f"input=({iid!r},{name!r}) second output={out2!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-3 checkout ----------------

def test_checkout_success_body_and_due_at():
    """checkout must return 200 with loan_id 1 and due_at = clock.now() + loan_period."""
    svc, clock = make()
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 1000.0 + 7.0}), f"input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"
    assert isinstance(out[1]["due_at"], float), f"due_at type output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_custom_loan_period():
    """checkout must compute due_at from the configured loan_period."""
    svc, clock = make(loan_period=2.5)
    clock.t = 40.0
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 42.5}), f"input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_user_404():
    """checkout must return 404 for an unregistered user."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.checkout("ghost", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('ghost','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_item_404():
    """checkout must return 404 for an item not in the catalog."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "nope")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m1','nope') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_user_checked_before_item():
    """checkout must return 404 when both the user and the item are unknown."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.checkout("ghost", "nope")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('ghost','nope') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_item_on_loan_409_even_for_same_user():
    """checkout must return 409 if the item has an active loan, including for the holder."""
    svc, _ = make()
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m2','i1') output={out!r}"
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_limit_422_default_three():
    """checkout must return 422 once the user holds max_loans (default 3) active loans."""
    svc, _ = make()
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        out = svc.checkout("m1", f"i{i}")
        assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m1','i{i}') output={out!r}"
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i4")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"input=('m1','i4') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_conflict_precedes_limit():
    """checkout must return 409 (item on loan) before 422 (limit) when both apply."""
    svc, _ = make()
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        assert svc.checkout("m1", f"i{i}")[0] == 200
    assert svc.checkout("m2", "i4")[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i4")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1','i4') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_limit_is_per_user():
    """checkout limit must apply per user, not globally."""
    svc, _ = make()
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        assert svc.checkout("m1", f"i{i}")[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i4")
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m2','i4') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_max_loans_zero_always_422():
    """checkout must return 422 for every checkout when max_loans is 0."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=0)
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"max_loans=0 input=('m1','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_loan_ids_sequential_global_and_failures_skip_none():
    """checkout must assign sequential loan_ids from 1 across users, unaffected by failed checkouts."""
    svc, _ = make()
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"] == 1
    assert svc.checkout("ghost", "i2")[0] == 404
    assert svc.checkout("m2", "i1")[0] == 409
    assert svc.checkout("m2", "nope")[0] == 404
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i2")
    assert out[1]["loan_id"] == 2, f"output={out!r}"
    out = svc.checkout("s1", "i3")
    assert out[1]["loan_id"] == 3, f"output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_reuse_item_after_return_new_loan_id():
    """checkout of a returned item must succeed and create a new loan with a new id."""
    svc, _ = make()
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[1]["loan_id"] == 1
    assert svc.return_loan("m1", 1)[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m2", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["loan_id"] == 2, f"input=('m2','i1') output={out!r}"


@given(n=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=5))
@settings(max_examples=30)
def test_checkout_property_max_loans_boundary(n):
    """checkout must allow exactly max_loans simultaneous active loans per user."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=n)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        out = svc.checkout("m1", f"i{i}")
        assert out[0] == 200, f"max_loans={n} item=i{i} output={out!r}"
    out = svc.checkout("m1", f"i{n + 1}")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"max_loans={n} extra output={out!r}"


def test_returning_frees_a_loan_slot():
    """checkout must count only active loans against max_loans so a return frees a slot."""
    svc, _ = make(max_loans=1)
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i1")[0] == 200
    assert svc.checkout("m1", "i2")[0] == 422
    assert svc.return_loan("m1", 1)[0] == 200
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i2")
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m1','i2') output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-4 / REQ-8 return_loan ----------------

def test_return_success_body_and_frees_item():
    """return_loan must return 200 with {item_id} and make the item available."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.return_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"
    st_ = svc.item_status("i1")
    assert st_ == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None}), f"item_status output={st_!r}"


def test_return_unknown_loan_404():
    """return_loan must return 404 for an unknown loan_id."""
    svc, _ = make()
    for who in ("m1", "s1"):
        out = svc.return_loan(who, 99)
        assert out[0] == 404, f"input=({who!r},99) output={out!r}"


def test_return_by_non_owner_member_403_and_no_state_change():
    """return_loan must return 403 for a member who does not own the loan and leave it active."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.return_loan("m2", 1)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2',1) output={out!r}"
    st_ = svc.item_status("i1")
    assert st_ == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": 1}), f"item_status output={st_!r}"


def test_return_by_staff_any_loan():
    """return_loan must allow staff to return a loan owned by someone else."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.return_loan("s1", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('s1',1) output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")
    assert loans[1][0]["status"] == "returned", f"list_loans output={loans!r}"


def test_return_twice_409():
    """return_loan must return 409 when the loan is already returned."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert svc.return_loan("m1", 1)[0] == 200
    out = svc.return_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1',1) second output={out!r}"
    out = svc.return_loan("s1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('s1',1) second output={out!r}"


def test_return_403_precedes_409():
    """return_loan must return 403 before 409 for a non-owner member on a returned loan."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    svc.return_loan("m1", 1)
    out = svc.return_loan("m2", 1)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2',1) output={out!r}"


def test_return_overdue_loan_allowed():
    """return_loan must succeed for an overdue active loan."""
    svc, clock = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    clock.t += 1000.0
    out = svc.return_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-5 / REQ-8 renew_loan ----------------

def test_renew_success_extends_from_due_at():
    """renew_loan must return 200 and set due_at = old due_at + loan_period."""
    svc, clock = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")  # due 1007
    clock.t = 1003.0
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0}), f"input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")
    assert loans[1][0]["due_at"] == 1014.0 and loans[1][0]["renewals_used"] == 1, f"list output={loans!r}"


def test_renew_unknown_loan_404():
    """renew_loan must return 404 for an unknown loan_id."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 5)
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('m1',5) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_non_owner_member_403():
    """renew_loan must return 403 for a member who does not own the loan."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.renew_loan("m2", 1)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2',1) output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")
    assert loans[1][0]["renewals_used"] == 0, f"list output={loans!r}"


def test_renew_by_staff_any_loan():
    """renew_loan must allow staff to renew any loan."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.renew_loan("s1", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0}), f"input=('s1',1) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_returned_409():
    """renew_loan must return 409 for a returned loan."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    svc.return_loan("m1", 1)
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_403_precedes_409_returned():
    """renew_loan must return 403 before 409 for non-owner on a returned loan."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    svc.return_loan("m1", 1)
    out = svc.renew_loan("m2", 1)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('m2',1) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_overdue_boundary():
    """renew_loan must allow renewal when now == due_at and return 409 when now > due_at."""
    svc, clock = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")  # due 1007
    clock.t = 1007.0
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0}), f"now==due input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"
    clock.t = 1014.5
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"now>due input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")
    assert loans[1][0]["due_at"] == 1014.0 and loans[1][0]["renewals_used"] == 1, f"list output={loans!r}"


def test_renew_overdue_precedes_limit():
    """renew_loan must return 409 (overdue) before 422 (limit) when both apply."""
    svc, clock = make(max_renewals=0)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    clock.t = 5000.0
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('m1',1) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_limit_default_two():
    """renew_loan must succeed twice by default and return 422 on the third attempt."""
    svc, _ = make()
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert svc.renew_loan("m1", 1) == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0})
    assert svc.renew_loan("m1", 1) == (200, {"due_at": 1021.0})
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 422, f"input=('m1',1) third output={out!r}"
    loans = svc.list_loans("m1")
    assert loans[1][0]["due_at"] == 1021.0 and loans[1][0]["renewals_used"] == 2, f"list output={loans!r}"


def test_renew_max_renewals_zero_422():
    """renew_loan must return 422 immediately when max_renewals is 0."""
    svc, _ = make(max_renewals=0)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 422, f"max_renewals=0 output={out!r}"


def test_renew_limit_is_per_loan():
    """renew_loan limit must apply per loan, not per user."""
    svc, _ = make(max_renewals=1)
    svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    svc.checkout("m1", "i2")
    assert svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)[0] == 200
    assert svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)[0] == 422
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 2)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('m1',2) output={out!r}"


@given(n=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=5),
       period=st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=20))
@settings(max_examples=40)
def test_renew_property_exact_n_renewals(n, period):
    """renew_loan must succeed exactly max_renewals times, each adding loan_period to due_at."""
    svc, clock = make(max_renewals=n, loan_period=float(period))
    out = svc.checkout("m1", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 1000.0 + period}), f"checkout output={out!r}"
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
        exp = (200, {"due_at": 1000.0 + period * (k + 1)})
        assert out == exp, f"max_renewals={n} period={period} k={k} output={out!r}"
    out = svc.renew_loan("m1", 1)
    assert out[0] == 422, f"max_renewals={n} period={period} extra output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-6 list_loans ----------------

def test_list_loans_unknown_user_404():
    """list_loans must return 404 for an unregistered user."""
    svc, _ = make()
    out = svc.list_loans("ghost")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('ghost',) output={out!r}"


def test_list_loans_empty():
    """list_loans must return 200 with an empty list for a user with no loans."""
    svc, _ = make()

ITEMS = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]


class Model:
    def __init__(self, max_loans, max_renewals, period):
        self.ml, self.mr, self.p = max_loans, max_renewals, period
        self.loans = {}
        self.active = {}
        self.next = 1

    def checkout(self, now, u, i):
        if u not in USERS:
            return 404, None
        if i not in ITEMS:
            return 404, None
        if i in self.active:
            return 409, None
        n = sum(1 for l in self.loans.values() if l["u"] == u and l["status"] == "active")
        if n >= self.ml:
            return 422, None
        lid = self.next
        self.next += 1
        self.loans[lid] = dict(u=u, i=i, due=now + self.p, r=0, status="active")
        self.active[i] = lid
        return 200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": now + self.p}

    def _gate(self, u, lid):
        if lid not in self.loans:
            return 404
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["u"] != u and USERS[u] != "staff":
            return 403
        return None

    def ret(self, now, u, lid):
        g = self._gate(u, lid)
        if g:
            return g, None
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        l["status"] = "returned"
        del self.active[l["i"]]
        return 200, {"item_id": l["i"]}

    def renew(self, now, u, lid):
        g = self._gate(u, lid)
        if g:
            return g, None
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        if now > l["due"]:
            return 409, None
        if l["r"] >= self.mr:
            return 422, None
        l["due"] += self.p
        l["r"] += 1
        return 200, {"due_at": l["due"]}

    def lst(self, u):
        return 200, [dict(loan_id=k, item_id=l["i"], due_at=l["due"],
                          renewals_used=l["r"], status=l["status"])
                     for k, l in sorted(self.loans.items()) if l["u"] == u]

    def status(self, i):
        if i not in ITEMS:
            return 404, None
        if i in self.active:
            return 200, {"available": False, "loan_id": self.active[i]}
        return 200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None}

            out = s.return_loan(a, b) if kind == "ret" else s.renew_loan(a, b)

                exp = (200, {"available": not act, "loan_id": act[0] if act else None})
            out = s.item_status(a)
        assert out == exp, f"op={op!r} output={out!r} expected={exp!r} history={ops!r}"

class Model:
    def __init__(self, clk, max_loans, max_renewals, period):
        self.clk, self.ml, self.mr, self.p = clk, max_loans, max_renewals, period
        self.loans = {}
        self.item_loan = {}
        self.next = 1

    def checkout(self, u, i):
        if i in self.item_loan:
            return 409, None
        active = sum(1 for l in self.loans.values() if l["u"] == u and l["status"] == "active")
        if active >= self.ml:
            return 422, None
        lid = self.next
        self.next += 1
        due = self.clk.now() + self.p
        self.loans[lid] = {"u": u, "item_id": i, "due_at": due, "renewals_used": 0, "status": "active"}
        self.item_loan[i] = lid
        return 200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": due}

    def ret(self, u, lid):
        l = self.loans.get(lid)
        if l is None:
            return 404, None
        if l["u"] != u and ROLES[u] != "staff":
            return 403, None
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        l["status"] = "returned"
        del self.item_loan[l["item_id"]]
        return 200, {"item_id": l["item_id"]}

    def renew(self, u, lid):
        l = self.loans.get(lid)
        if l is None:
            return 404, None
        if l["u"] != u and ROLES[u] != "staff":
            return 403, None
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        if self.clk.now() > l["due_at"]:
            return 409, None
        if l["renewals_used"] >= self.mr:
            return 422, None
        l["due_at"] = l["due_at"] + self.p
        l["renewals_used"] += 1
        return 200, {"due_at": l["due_at"]}

    def lst(self, u):
        out = []
        for lid in sorted(self.loans):
            l = self.loans[lid]
            if l["u"] == u:
                out.append({"loan_id": lid, "item_id": l["item_id"], "due_at": l["due_at"],
                            "renewals_used": l["renewals_used"], "status": l["status"]})
        return 200, out

    def status(self, i):
        lid = self.item_loan.get(i)
        return 200, {"available": lid is None, "loan_id": lid}

USERS = ["staff", "alice", "bob", "carol"]
ROLES = {"staff": "staff", "alice": "member", "bob": "member", "carol": "member"}
ITEMS = ["i0", "i1", "i2", "i3", "i4"]


class Model:
    def __init__(self, clk, ml, mr, p):
        self.clk, self.ml, self.mr, self.p = clk, ml, mr, p
        self.loans, self.item_loan, self.next = {}, {}, 1

    def checkout(self, u, i):
        if u not in ROLES:
            return 404, None
        if i not in ITEMS:
            return 404, None
        if i in self.item_loan:
            return 409, None
        if sum(1 for l in self.loans.values() if l["u"] == u and l["status"] == "active") >= self.ml:
            return 422, None
        lid, self.next = self.next, self.next + 1
        due = self.clk.now() + self.p
        self.loans[lid] = {"u": u, "item_id": i, "due_at": due, "renewals_used": 0, "status": "active"}
        self.item_loan[i] = lid
        return 200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": due}

    def _gate(self, u, lid):
        l = self.loans.get(lid)
        if l is None:
            return 404, None
        if l["u"] != u and ROLES.get(u) != "staff":
            return 403, None
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        return None

    def ret(self, u, lid):
        g = self._gate(u, lid)
        if g:
            return g
        l = self.loans[lid]
        l["status"] = "returned"
        del self.item_loan[l["item_id"]]
        return 200, {"item_id": l["item_id"]}

    def renew(self, u, lid):
        g = self._gate(u, lid)
        if g:
            return g
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if self.clk.now() > l["due_at"]:
            return 409, None
        if l["renewals_used"] >= self.mr:
            return 422, None
        l["due_at"] += self.p
        l["renewals_used"] += 1
        return 200, {"due_at": l["due_at"]}

    def lst(self, u):
        if u not in ROLES:
            return 404, None
        return 200, [{"loan_id": k, "item_id": l["item_id"], "due_at": l["due_at"],
                      "renewals_used": l["renewals_used"], "status": l["status"]}
                     for k, l in sorted(self.loans.items()) if l["u"] == u]

    def status(self, i):
        if i not in ITEMS:
            return 404, None
        lid = self.item_loan.get(i)
        return 200, {"available": lid is None, "loan_id": lid}
